issues.on_page: Business-Type Activities rows 45, 47, 48 printed in the GENERAL FUND column
issues.issue: The form puts 149,753.15 of utility spending under Business-Type Activities, but it is paid from the General Fund column, so the extractor treated it as governmental by column (marked review). The matching utility receipts are presumably inside General Fund 'Local Receipts: Other' 157,782.48 (receipts[9], category other). A person should decide whether these utility operations belong in business-type. Applies to disbursements[5], [6] and [7]

'other' makes up about 52% of governmental receipts (well over the 10% review threshold). Most of it is likely water/sewer/refuse charges collected in the General Fund, but the form does not say so. Marked review
Assumed to be utility charges from the column. The form line is 'Other' (marked review)
